ns2:section.sectionText: Origins of Western Literature, 3 hours. An examination of the influence of Plautus and Terence on European drama. This course satisfies the General Education Criteria for a Literature and the Arts, and Western Compartive Culture course. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
